fusions.name: Pronged Verdict
fusions.desc: A finishing blow with two prongs that deals 24 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Crossing Cracks
fusions.desc: Cracks the ground around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. It then forks to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Parting Wall
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of stone 4 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Tines Converge
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (82% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
